t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Create a list in your mind of colors that you find through trial and error during the 1x rounds. Use the list that you have constructed in your mind for the 5x rounds.

vb_textbox.text: Use the 1x rounds to learn what colors are better. Pay attention to the colors when making your selection. If the number after making the color selection is very low then remember the other color. If the number is high, then remember the color that you chose. It might be helpful to repeat the colors that were better to yourself over and over. Use the 5x rounds to select colors that you know were better. Take the opportunity to look at colors that you haven't selected before in order to learn whether they are good or bad. How good each color is changes so it is important to rebuild your list in your mind during the 1x rounds.
